name: Login Screen Designer
author: Devmont Digital

sections.description:
Login Screen Designer is a lightweight plugin that allows you to personalize the WordPress login screen effortlessly. From customizing the logo to adjusting background colors and welcome messages, it provides essential tools to match the login page with your brand identity.

🎯 Use Cases:
– White-label WordPress login page for clients
– Match login page design to your brand or website
– Improve the user experience for custom logins

🚀 Core Features:

  • Upload a custom logo for the login page
  • Change background image or color
  • Customize the login form background and text styles
  • Live preview settings inside the admin

🛠️ Admin Panel:
– Dedicated settings page under *Login Screen Designer**
– Instant preview of login page changes
– Easy-to-use color pickers and text fields

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder login-screen-designer to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Login Screen Designer in the admin dashboard to begin customizing.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin work with all themes?

Yes, it works independently of your theme and affects only the login page.

Can I reset settings to default?

Currently, resetting is manual, but default values are easy to restore.

Is it compatible with other login plugins?

It works with most plugins unless they completely override the login page.
